title: Amazon Basics Neoprene Dumbbell Hand Weights for Exercise and Muscle Toning
features: SHIPMENT CONTAINS: 2 pound dumbbell hand weight (set of 2) for exercise and strength training
LONG-LASTING NEOPRENE COATING: Pink neoprene texture offers long lasting durability and comfortable grip during workouts
HEXAGON SHAPED ENDS: Prevents dumbbells from rolling away and offers stay-in-place storage
NONSLIP GRIP: Promotes a comfortable, secure hold during various exercises
COLOR CODED IDENTIFICATION: Printed weight number on each end cap and color coded for quick identification; available in multiple sizes to mix and match for specific workout needs
